name: How can I tell if a drywall crack indicates a serious structural problem?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a drywall crack indicates a serious structural problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a serious structural problem include long, horizontal cracks across walls, cracks forming a stair-step pattern in masonry, cracks wider than 1/4 inch, or cracks accompanied by doors or windows that stick. If you notice cracks in multiple areas of your home, especially near the foundation, or if they appear suddenly and grow rapidly, it's crucial to have a professional structural engineer or experienced general contractor assess the situation immediately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Long, wide, stair-step cracks, sticking doors/windows, or sudden, rapidly growing cracks can indicate a serious structural problem requiring professional assessment.
